companion_guidance: CPS 230 Operational Risk Management (critical functions are critical operations)
summary: CPS 900 supports APRA in preparing resolution plans for entities it notifies. The entity and its Board must support APRA's resolution planning, may be required to analyse critical functions, assess resolvability, implement pre-positioning plans, maintain financial resources (including loss-absorbing capacity for non-RSE entities) and maintain capabilities to support resolution, and must notify APRA of material changes that may create barriers to resolution.

clauses.heading: Application on APRA notification
clauses.text: The standard commenced on 1 January 2024, but an entity is subject to its requirements only after APRA notifies it.

clauses.heading: Support APRA's resolution plan
clauses.text: The entity must support APRA in developing and maintaining a resolution plan, and the Board is ultimately responsible for ensuring the entity meets the standard (para 16).

clauses.heading: Resolution capabilities
clauses.text: The entity must establish and maintain the capabilities required to support the resolution plan, including resolution governance arrangements, operational capabilities, financial management, data and systems, and where appropriate a restructuring plan; APRA may require additional capabilities (para 29).
clauses.notes: Critical functions under CPS 900 are expected to be classified as critical operations under CPS 230 (CPG 230 para 17).

clauses.heading: Notify barriers to resolution
clauses.text: The entity must notify APRA of material changes to its business or operations that may create a barrier to resolution.
clauses.notification_trigger: On a material change that may create a barrier to resolution (no fixed period stated).
